quote: It should be practised for gaining steady posture, health and lightness of body.
meaning: Asana comes first. We practise it to feel steady, healthy and light.

quote: 22 studies: yoga gave older adults better balance, stronger legs, more flexibility, better mood and sleep.
meaning: Yoga is not only for the young.

quote: 12 weekly yoga classes helped long-term back pain about as much as 15 physical therapy visits.
meaning: A gentle weekly class can be a real choice for back pain.

quote: Be strong, and enter into your own body: for there your foothold is firm.
meaning: Stop looking far away for strength. Come home to your own body.

quote: 410 cancer survivors: 4 weeks of gentle yoga helped them sleep better and use fewer sleeping pills.
meaning: Gentle breathing, soft asana and rest, after cancer treatment.

quote: Breast cancer survivors who did yoga had 57% less tiredness, 3 months after the classes ended.
meaning: The lead scientist thinks the breathing and meditation parts mattered a lot.

who: Top cancer doctor groups (ASCO and SIO) · 2023
quote: They now say yoga may be offered for worry and sadness in people with cancer.
meaning: Yoga is part of official cancer care advice. Next to treatment, never instead of it.

quote: After 8 weeks of yoga, period pain was 2.75 points lower (out of 10) than with no exercise.
meaning: Steady practice may make painful periods easier.

quote: Found to have asthma at 14, she later set a marathon world record that stood for 16 years.
meaning: Asthma doesn't have to stop you. She worked with her doctor and her medicine.

quote: He says yoga helped him play 20 NBA seasons, until age 42, with few injuries.
meaning: One man's story. He also trained martial arts. A strong example of steady practice.
